messages:
Asha: Ops flagged a small but noticeable error burst on embeddings during the webinar signup window. Ops says mitigation is underway. Need marketing + SDR routing + status copy.
Tom: Can we pause the benchmark tweet and webinar reminder? Want to avoid pushing content while issues are visible.
Ivy: Agreed. Draft short statuspage line: 'Investigating elevated errors impacting the embeddings API for a subset of requests. Engineers are working on a mitigation; next update in 30 minutes.' Keep it non-technical.
Diego: Root cause looks like KV hotspotting triggering GPU memory pressure on a narrow key prefix. We're throttling batches and evicting hotspots. Expect improvement in ~15-25m.
Asha: Timing plan: 1) Hold all outbound marketing (social, benchmark blog publish) immediately. 2) Update support macro in 5m. 3) Post status once 5xx < 1% or at +20m. 4) Resume marketing after 60m stable.
Tom: Support macro suggestion: 'Thanks — we're aware of an issue affecting embeddings for some requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we'll update within 30 minutes. If this affects production traffic, reply and we'll escalate.'
Ivy: For the webinar audience: pause the reminder email. Draft a short note to registrants if necessary: 'We're investigating a platform issue and pausing reminders. We'll confirm the session in ~1 hour.'
SDRBot: Rule update: tag inbound leads that mention errors with 'incident-priority' and assign to Asha + Tom.
OpsBot: Mitigation applied at 1702509990 3: reduced batch sizes, warmed alternative pools, evicted hot keys. Monitoring.
Diego: 5xx rate down from 2.4% to 0.5% over the last 8m. Still observing occasional spikes while eviction finishes.
Asha: OK, publish short status now: 'Partial service disruption for embeddings; mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes.' Tom + Diego sign off?
Tom: Sign-off from marketing. I'll hold socials and blog publish for another hour.
Diego: Ops sign-off for statusline. Will ping when stable for 60m.
Ivy: Support macros and webinar hold updated. Will prepare a lightweight follow-up email template in case registrants ask.
Asha: Thanks everyone 3 keeping SDRs paused on outreach for incident-tagged leads until we clear. I'll post final all-clear when Ops confirms hour of stability.
